ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) background with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels, estimated at approximately 1:12 across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white cluster located at the left distal tip. Dispersed white focal spots located across both the medial and lateral regions of the left and right lobes. High-intensity pixel accumulation observed at the proximal interface with the water surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth extends significantly into the central fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing boundary. Notable macro-peaks at the distal tips and multiple micro-valleys (depth 3-8 pixels) distributed along the lobe perimeters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convexity; the left lobe displays a more acute upward sweep toward the tip, while the right lobe follows a broader, more horizontal convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of over 20 localized circular high-contrast white pixel clusters across both lobes; some exhibit concentric ring structures (rosettes) typical of barnacle colonization scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the medial-lower portion of the right lobe, appearing as darker-than-base-tissue rake marks oriented vertically.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular tissue loss/notching on the right lobe's trailing edge near the distal tip; significant white scarring/pigmentation at the fluke-peduncle junction.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast white 'teardrop' shape located on the upper medial region of the left lobe.
